procedure.en: Turn the external ring clockwise to the starting point where resistance starts, not the tightest position. That is zero; check that the indicator sits at #0. Count rotations, numbers and clicks counter-clockwise from there. Do not turn the handle within the first few clicks from zero.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o anel externo no sentido horário até o ponto inicial em que a resistência começa, não a posição mais apertada. Esse é o zero; confira se o indicador está no #0. Conte as voltas, os números e os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali. Não gire a manivela nos primeiros cliques a partir do zero.

notes: External ring: 6 numbers per rotation (0–5), 60 clicks per rotation, 10 clicks per number; 4.5 rotations = 270 clicks. 12.5 µm per click (0.0125 mm) is 1Zpresso's published burr travel, not particle size. X-Pro S differs only by the foldable handle; the X-Ultra's official chart is pixel-identical and its Honest Coffee Guide values differ by 1–5 clicks (see band notes). Zero tolerance of 2 clicks is a working figure: 1Zpresso states none for the X series. All values stored as clicks from zero.
